notes.title: BH FULL GAME RELEASE
notes.content:
Dear Users and BH Fans,

We're delighted to share that the full version of the game is now complete. If you engaged with it during the early access phase, you'll notice substantial evolution even from just a few months ago. We invite you to revisit and share your feedback. We aim to deliver an experience that surpasses your expectations, addressing reported issues promptly. The current version boasts increased diversity and sophistication across various aspects. Introducing new gameplay modes like battles and rogue, we've retained the classic BeachHead arcade mode. Particularly in VR, significant performance improvements have been made, and we're committed to ongoing enhancements across the entire gaming experience. Your trust and input are invaluable, and we appreciate your ongoing support.  

In addition and for those of you who have been asking for us to rehabilitate the original BH2K
games we're thrilled to share that we've resolved the compatibility issues, and the game should now work seamlessly on Windows 10-11. Please check the rehabilitated classic BeachHead games below:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/509610/Beachhead_2000/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/511660/Beachhead_2002/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/614770/Beachhead_DESERT_WAR/

Best Regards,

Pepe Moreno & the Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39105118/7c4d3c17de40437b9891129a7e3d89d19d3b6e1e.jpg[/img]
BeachHead new Launcher

[b]Here's a summary of the significant updates we've made:[/b]

BH Graphics

[list][*][b]Graphics Enhancements[/b]: Significant improvements in graphics and lighting create a more immersive and true-to-life experience. The game features a time continuum with dynamic skies and realistic day and night battles.[/list]
[list][*][b]Enhanced Sounds and Special Effects[/b]: The addition of immersive audio and special effects enhances the overall gaming experience. Players can now experience damage progression, destructible objects, explosion shockwaves, secondary explosions, and more.[/list]

BH Weapons and Gameplay

[list][*][b]Restructured Gameplay[/b]: The game now boasts a completely restructured and dynamic rogue-like gameplay, offering infinite variations and multiple difficulty levels. The essentials remain the same, but now everything is integrated into a coherent in-game economy and marketplace, allowing users to earn and trade for weapons.[/list]
[list][*][b]Expanded Arsenal and Weapon functionality[/b]: The game introduces numerous new weapons, and there's more in the pipeline. A standout feature allows users to wield multiple weapons simultaneously, enabling dynamic and seamless switching. From Falk guns to miniguns, personal weapons, pistols, and everything in between, players have a diverse arsenal at their disposal.[/list]
[list][*][b]New Support Weapons[/b]: Complementing primary and personal weapons, a range of support systems has been introduced to assist players in challenging situations. This includes artillery and air support, along with sophisticated turrets that synchronize with the user's intentions.[/list]
[list][*][b]Multiple defense posts[/b]: Enjoy the flexibility of fighting and switching from various positions with different weapons and points of view including moving vehicles and even from the air. Discover creative ways to attack the enemy from unexpected vantage points, adding an exciting element to your strategic approach.[/list]

BH Characters

[list][*][b]New Character-Defenders with their own set of skills[/b]: Everything in BH is now character-centric and as it should be. I’m a comic book artist and storyteller by (previous) trade and this has always been my intention and now is a reality. Meet the BH DEFENDERS Each of them with specific attributes and skills for you to adapt (or use as AI defenders to assist you in future battles.[/list]
[list][*][b]New Enemy Characters and Machines[/b]: Good and bad guys are defenders and attackers in a world that makes human sense along with more powerful and lethal weapons and machines to fight from or defend against. Humans augmented along with suicidal robots (bosses) and drones.[/list]

BHC Game Economy

[list][*][b]Revamped Game Economy[/b]: We've introduced an in-game currency along fully functional and fully integrated new in-game economy. The BHC or supple the beachhead credit is what you earn and are rewarded with to get ahead in the game and the beachhead world.[/list]
[list][*][b]BHC credit earnings and Rewards[/b]: In addition to the BH credits you earn for kills during gameplay, there's an extra bonus reward if you emerge victorious in the battle. The more battles you win, the greater your buying power becomes, increasing your chances of winning more battles and, in turn, earning more rewards. It's a cycle of success![/list]
[list][*][b]Full Integration of BH Marketplace[/b]: The BH marketplace is now seamlessly integrated into the game, playing a vital role in your gaming experience.[/list]

BH Game Interface

[list][*][b]Revamped Game Interface[/b]: Enjoy a brand-new user-friendly and seamless game interface. With all the bells and whistles along with in and out of the game functionality.[/list]
[list][*][b]Weapons and Enhancing Combat Accessories[/b]: Choose from dozens of combat accessories to add to your inventory and enhance your gameplay.[/list]

These updates represent our commitment to making BeachHead Battles an even more thrilling and engaging experience for our players.

notes.title: Major VR Performance Update
notes.content:
This is one of many upcoming performance updates aimed at maximizing your gaming experience. With this update, our focus is on refining the game's performance, particularly for VR devices.

[b]Key Changes:[/b]

[b]Rendering Optimization:[/b]

We've transitioned from multi-pass rendering to single-pass instanced rendering, a significant enhancement that promises a notable boost in VR performance. This transition required extensive modifications across shaders, materials, particle systems, effects, and assets.
Engine Upgrade:

Our BeachHead project has been upgraded to the latest engine version, facilitating the rendering change. This upgrade also introduces additional engine optimizations that benefit the game's performance across the board.

[b]Skybox Optimization:[/b]

In the VR version, we've replaced the volumetric skybox with a static skybox. While the visual changes may seem subtle, this adjustment significantly improves performance without compromising the immersive day and night cycle. The skybox material seamlessly transitions between different time settings.

[b]Additional Enhancements:[/b]

[b]Asset Updates:[/b] Numerous assets have been revised and updated to ensure optimal performance and visual consistency.

[b]Gameplay Fine-Tuning:[/b] We've seized the opportunity to refine various gameplay aspects, including visual effects, ensuring a smoother and more immersive experience.

[b]Ongoing Commitment:[/b]

This update marks just the beginning of our ongoing efforts to enhance BeachHead. We remain dedicated to addressing player feedback and continually improving the game. While we've conducted extensive testing, it's possible that unforeseen issues may arise. We appreciate your support and encourage you to reach out if you encounter any issues.

notes.title: BH XMAS SPECIAL!
notes.content:
Dear Users and BH Fans,

We're thrilled to share that the full version of the game is now complete. Originally, we planned a Holiday release, but wisdom prevailed. Competing during the winter Xmas Steam sales can be challenging, so we've decided to wait for a more favorable release date in January. In the meantime, we're updating the current version to the final one, allowing those who've pre-purchased the full-access version to get an early taste and the opportunity to get ahead in the game. Your support means the world to us, and it fuels our dedication to providing the best gaming experience.

Best Regards,

Pepe Moreno & the Team

notes.title: [Hotfix - 1.2.2.2]
[Hotfix] 1.2.2.1 - Guest Mode & Weapons Handling Changes
Update [1.2.2] VR HTC Vive Fix and the Storm is Returning!
notes.content:
Hello dear BeachHead fans and early supporters,

We've been quiet for a while, but we haven't forgotten about you! We're back and fully focused on making BeachHead the best it can be. This update is just the first step in a series of updates that will bring BeachHead to the next level. We appreciate everyone's patience and guarantee that this patience will pay off in the near future!
In this particular update we worked on the following items:

[list]
[*] New graphics
We've made a lot of graphical improvements and this is just the beginning. We are focused on improving the game visuals along with gameplay improvements. Gameplay, performance and visuals are our priority now.

[*] Performance improvements
Performance has always been treated with care by our team, in this version we have made many performance improvements. In the next versions we will continue working on performance improvements for Desktop and VR.

[*] OpenXR integration
We completely reworked all VR related code. Now we are using OpenXR, which is a development standard for VR. With this change we will have a standardized way of working with different VR devices and features. This will open the door for faster and easier ways to include new VR features and improvements.

[*] HTC Vive Compatibility Update
Updates and bugfixes to fix compatibility issues with the HTC Vive in addition these updates should also cover all OpenVR compatible devices (Oculus Quest, Valve index, etc).

[*] New Game Launcher
We created a game launcher that will make authentication easier for all platforms and will have all BeachHead components in one place. This will be used to integrate all future BeachHead products.

[*] Rebuilt code structure to support many new and more ambitious features in future updates.
We expect to release a major update soon, in which we will introduce a new gameplay mode and activate the BHC marketplace. Stay tuned as we will be making an announcement soon.
[/list]

Thank you again for your support, we love you guys!

notes.title: BH ROGHE "BATTLE TEST"
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39105118/7f63a5165f8bd09b52c03cc145a36311d9f539a6.jpg[/img]

[h3]BeachHead Rogue Test Battle[/h3]

Dear Steam players and dedicated BeachHead fans,

We have an exciting announcement to make! Introducing BeachHead Rogue, a brand new gameplay version of our game that is set to be released separately. As a token of appreciation for your unwavering support and early access purchase, we are offering BeachHead Rogue as a free update exclusively for our original supporters.

Welcome to "BeachHead Rogue," a new stand-alone version of the popular BeachHead 2000 game series. BeachHead Rogue is a new gameplay dynamic in the best Rogue-Like style, with dozens of different abilities and weapons and infinite variations of gameplay. Choose your abilities and weapons and build the best strategy to master the BeachHead defenses against the MussoKhan forces. 

Please note that BeachHead Rogue is a test version and we value your feedback immensely. We would be thrilled if you could provide insights and suggestions to help us improve the game further. As a gesture of gratitude the BHC credit points you accumulate in this version will be seamlessly added to your general BH wallet, allowing you to use them directly in the marketplace and in the forthcoming full-release version here on Steam (August 2023).

Moreover, we encourage you to reach out to us and share your feedback. As a special thank you, we will reward you with an additional 10,000 BHC in your wallet score. Your input will be invaluable in shaping the game and the future of BeachHead.

We are not going anywhere. Thank you once again for your continued support. Let's embark on this thrilling new adventure together in BeachHead Rogue!


Sincerely,

Pepe Moreno & BH Team

notes.title: NEW BH2020 SURVIVAL TOURNAMENT (STARTS JULY 4TH 2021)
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that survival competitions resume in July and will become a regular feature!  Newly powered by our own game server, we can now run multiple competitions without erasing the existing high scores of players on Steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39105118/f070311a1d15b415f96c297d0bd17c09cf8768d0.jpg[/img]

[b]BH UNIVERSAL LEADERBOARD[/b].  The new BH database will be universal across platforms so that everyone can play in the same game or tournament!  Scores will be recorded and displayed for everyone to see, AND you will be able to convert your score points into BHC (game credits) later on.

[h3]AND WHY SHOULD YOU CARE ABOUT YOUR SCORE ACCOMPLISHMENTS?[/h3]
 
WHY IS THIS IMPORTANT TO YOU? Because [u]your score is money![/u]  Starting in Q4 2021, you will be able to convert your score points into BHC credits (your BH in-game-world currency). With BHC, you can buy assets to use in the BH game-world to simply enjoy, or better your chances of success.  You can also sell them back into the BH Marketplace in exchange for more BHC credits (to buy other things that you like in the game). 

[h3]START EARNING NOW[/h3]

Yes!  Starting in July (4th) 2021, scores from all BH2020 game versions (past and present, arcade and survival competitions) will be tallied together in our new database, AND IF YOU REGISTER into your very own BH Wallet!  Once you have a wallet, you'll be able to convert your score points into BHC credits.  So what are you waiting for?  You can start earning now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39105118/8105b079d54fdceb938bfbb89db3d18a12dd1f42.jpg[/img]

[h3]COMPETITION CATEGORIES[/h3]

ALL Competitions reset at the end of each calendar month.  Player’s scores return to zero in each category, however,  players stay in the category they qualified for.  Once you have qualified for a category, you remain in it, unless your score drops below that category’s range. There are 4 levels of competition:
[list]
[*] Beginners Competition.
[*] Veterans Competition.
[*] Aces Competition.
[*] DeathMatch Competition.
[/list]
[*] [b]BEGINNERS[/b].  Every player starts the game in the beginner’s category.  The top X players of the month/week will go to the Veteran’s Competition.  This is a starting competition, so players can't drop down in rank by failing to score above the average.

[*] [b]VETERANS[/b].  Top players in the Beginner’s Competitions from the previous month will qualify for the Veteran’s Competition.  The top X players of the month/week will go to the Aces Competition.  Players that do not qualify for the following Aces Competition will remain in the Veteran’s category to try again in the next competition.   Players who score below average will go back to the Beginners Competition.

[*] [b]ACES[/b]. Top players in Veterans Competitions from the previous month will be in the Ace Competition.  Ace players that do not qualify for the following DeathMatch Competition will remain in the category to try again in the next competition.  The top X players of the month will be allowed to go into the DeathMatch Competition.  Players who score below average there will go back to the Veterans Competition.

[*] [b]DEATHMATCH[/b].  Players will challenge each other in a one-on-one match (score vs score).  The winner gets ALL the score points, including those of the losing player.  The losing player will start over in the Beginner’s Competition.

[h3]NEW RULES[/h3]

SURVIVAL MODE means that you play non-stop until you die (game over).  It's ALL OR NOTHING and it has to be all on the same game save. Your top score gets recorded along with the waves you survived and the time used. Your total score along with your name and profile photo will show on the BH (and Steam) LeaderBoard and in your profile score tab. SURVIVAL is a "valor-skill-challenge" that will allow you to jumpstart and make your mark in the world of BeachHead.  This is the first step in the evolution of the game and the start of the game economy.
[list]
[*]  [b]TIMELINE[/b]. The timeline is open, players can enter anytime by clicking on the "survival" button and start playing.  Every month (at the end of the month) we will tally up the best players' scores.
There are no restrictions, you can play and try to beat your top score as many times as you want.  Your highest score is recorded and so you will not be set back if you had a bad run.

[*] [b]WHO WINS?[/b]: Top ten players will show up on the scoreboard at the calendar end date of every month in every category.

[*] [b]HOW TO WIN[/b]: The more you play, the better you will get, and the longer you will survive.  Practice and hone your skills first, and then focus on playing your best game.

[*] [b]WHAT YOU WIN[/b]: Your score will earn you a rank with corresponding medals and decorations that grant you certain in-game privileges.  The higher the scores, the higher the rank and prestige of the medal.  If you die a lot that's okay, you'll receive a Purple Heart Medal regardless to honor your service.
[/list]
[h3]REQUIREMENTS[/h3]
[list]
[*] An active profile, email verification, and proof of legal purchase are required.
Anyone can participate, but only legal owners will be able to benefit from rewards and collect their prizes (proof of purchase required).
[/list]
[h3]ADDITIONAL PRICES & REWARDS[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39105118/0dcbfeb9159e4e807c9e5af0d19c93ff2e5b227f.jpg[/img]
[list]
[b]RANK[/b]: Rank is of extreme importance in Beachhead because it allows exclusive access to weapons and features others cannot access. Rank determines your status and prestige in the game. Rank will be assigned on the score tally relative to all others, but the minimal score under each category will be based on your highest score of all time (total score). [/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39105118/c588c6a7f54898d8311f77dbd20868a4d5af37e1.jpg[/img]
[list]
[b]MEDALS[/b]:  HEROS are recognized and rewarded with medals in BeachHead.  If you become a HERO in the game it is very significant because people will look up to you and your accomplishments.  If you have a good reputation, it will follow you all the way to the full version of the game!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39105118/3e40cbe6cb84639690934df202af7a0f1536a2d5.jpg[/img]
[list]
[b]BADGES[/b]: Badges give you STATUS and assign you to a class.  At the base level, everyone begins as a Citizen, after that comes Soldier, and Defender.  Not everyone has to be a soldier, but everyone between the ages of 13 and 45 has to serve in the Defense Force (BDF), or in some defense capacity supporting the fighting force.  Everyone is welcome to join the fight if they choose to - unless there's a disaster and everyone has to fight.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39105118/177aeffaf620617da04189268c25bf4ab821dbaa.jpg[/img]      
[list]
[b]BHC CREDITS[/b]: 10,000 BHC will be rewarded to each competition's TOP-TEN WINNER and 1,000 BHC each to the rest of the top ten contenders.  BHC is the in-game currency that allows you to buy in-game objects, weapons, and accessories.  For the time being, the BeachHead economy is focused on game items that relate to combat.  However, BHC is not only the in-game currency but the currency of the entire BeachHead universe.  Once BH CITY opens, players will be able to use their money to buy property and "civilian" lifestyle items.
[/list]

notes.title: BH2020 SURVIVAL COMPETITION
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39105118/c6ab10ae49dad49db6bd42cc3a81c67a58482f18.jpg[/img]

[h3]Andrew, aka MR. REAPER is the undisputed winner of the First (February) "SURVIVAL" Competition with no less than a [b]773,820[/b] point score and almost twice ahead of the runner-up. May your valor be recognized through the ages, or until someone else beats your score[/h3]

notes.title: BH2020 SURVIVAL COMPETITION
notes.content:
This is a "valor-skill" challenge that will allow you to jumpstart and make your mark in the world of BeachHead. Not just fun and games, but a true challenge of your skills and endurance. Everything from here onward is going to be connected -and consequential- in the full version of the game. This is the first step in the evolution of the game. Users can wait for the full version (late spring) or get started now and get ahead. Getting in now you pay less than half while helping us with the development. Obviously, we encourage you to participate now and help us out, but make no mistake you're not missing a beat and you'll be playing the game at full tilt. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39105118/d73d34b1b78c876560649e8dbb5c63c276f8a1f2.jpg[/img]

[h3]RULE ADJUSTMENTS[/h3]

Given what we have learned from the first contest, we realized that we need a leaderboard database outside of Steam to run the contest properly.  The Steam leaderboard is not flexible enough to reset the contest without wiping out the scores, and we don't want to do that. WE ARE NOW WRITING THE CODE TO DO JUST THAT, AND WE'LL BE MAKING A NEW CONTEST ANNOUNCEMENT AHEAD OF TIME, MOST LIKELY IN APRIL. 

[list]
[*] [b]What is it[/b]: Survival mode means that you play non-stop until you die (game over). It's all or nothing and it has to be all on the same game save. Your top score gets recorded along with the waves you survived and the time used. Your total score along with your name and profile photo will show on the BH (and Steam) LeaderBoard and in your profile score tab. 

[*] [b]Timeline[/b]: The timeline is open, players can enter anytime by clicking on the "survival" button and start playing. Every month (at the end of the month) we will tally up the best players' scores and proceed to award designated prizes to the TOP TEN players (please see illustrations below). The first competition starts now and will end on February 27 (2021). 

[*] [b]Rules[/b]: Players can enter anytime by pressing the "survival" button. There are no restrictions, you can play it anytime and try to beat your top score as many times as you want. Your highest score remains recorded so you are not set back just because you had a bad run. Anyone can participate, but only legal owners will be able to benefit from rewards and collect their prizes (proof of purchase required).

[*] [b]Required[/b]: An active profile and email for verification and proof of legal purchase.

[*] [b]Who wins[/b]: Top ten players to show up on the scoreboard at the calendar ending date of every month.

[*] [b]How to Win[/b]: The better you are and the more you play and practice the better you'll get and survive the longest. Practice and hone your skills and then focus and play your best game.

[*] [b]What you Win[/b]: Above all, your score will get you a rank which, in turn, comes with in-game privileges. Same thing with medals and decorations. The higher the scores, the higher the rank and the prestige of the medal. If you die a lot that's okay, you'll receive a Purple Heart regardless.
[/list]
[h3]REWARDS & PRICES[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39105118/0dcbfeb9159e4e807c9e5af0d19c93ff2e5b227f.jpg[/img]

[b]Rank[/b]: Rank is of extreme importance in Beachhead as it will allow access to weapons and features others cannot access. Rank determines your hierarchy and prestige status in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39105118/c588c6a7f54898d8311f77dbd20868a4d5af37e1.jpg[/img] 

[b]Medals[/b]: Heroes are recognized and rewarded in BeachHead. Your medals are very important in the world of the game. People will look up to you and your accomplishments and having a good reputation will follow you all the way to the full version of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39105118/3e40cbe6cb84639690934df202af7a0f1536a2d5.jpg[/img]

[b]Badges[/b]: Badges are to give you status and belonging to a class. At the core level, everyone needs to be a Citizen, after that comes being a soldier and a defender. Not everyone has to a soldier, but everyone over the age of (13-45) has to serve in the Defense Force (BDF), or in some defense capacity supporting the fighting force. Everyone is welcome to join the fight at the front of course unless there's big trouble and everyone has to fight.        

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39105118/177aeffaf620617da04189268c25bf4ab821dbaa.jpg[/img]

[b]BHC credits[/b]: 10,000 BHC will be rewarded to each competition's top-ten winner and 1,000 BHC each to the rest of the top ten contenders. BHC is the in-game currency that allows you to buy in-game objects, weapons, and accessories. For the time being, the BeachHead economy is focused on game items that relate to combat. However, BHC is not only the in-game currency but the currency of the entire BeacHead universe. Once the BH CITY opens later in the year, players will be able to use their money to buy property and "civilian" lifestyle items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39105118/4740ea6fd8706b7e4c8b058fea262df847962b3f.jpg[/img]

[b]BH Merch[/b]: In addition to the top survival scores awarded above (once a month), BH Merch items will be awarded (raffle) among the winners. BeachHead front wear is pretty cool from what you can see. It's all high-quality and designed to fit well and suit you. You can buy the items yourself later on, but why not take the chance to earn them right now.
